name: RingSystemEA v4.0
summary: A multi-currency ring hedging EA that creates triangular currency pair groups from 3-8 currencies, generating up to 56 ring combinations. It opens simultaneous buy/sell positions across each ring's three pairs (Plus and Minus suites) to exploit temporary pricing imbalances, with configurable step progression, lot progression, and basket/single close logic.
summary_zh: 多货币环形对冲EA，从3至8种货币中构建三角货币对组合（最多56个环），对每个环的三对同时开立买/卖仓位组合（正套与反套），利用临时价格失衡获利，支持步进递进、手数递进及篮子/单笔平仓逻辑。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是三角套利/环形对冲：从用户指定的货币中按组合数学生成所有三元组，每个三元组构成一个'环'（3对货币对）。对每个环同时开立'Plus套组'（Buy/Sell/Buy）和'Minus套组'（Sell/Buy/Sell），本质是对冲三对间的汇率关系偏差。入场条件为初始开仓后，若浮亏达到设定步进值则加仓（支持静态、几何、指数步进）。出场支持单笔获利平仓和篮子获利平仓两种模式，也可设定亏损平仓。仓位管理支持手动手数、自动手数（基于风险因子）、公平手数分配，以及静态/几何/指数/递减手数递进。资金管理包含最大手数限制、最大订单数限制、点差过滤、交易时段控制和滑点控制。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is triangular arbitrage/ring hedging: from user-specified currencies it generates all 3-currency combinations (rings), each containing 3 currency pairs. For each ring it simultaneously opens a 'Plus suite' (Buy/Sell/Buy) and a 'Minus suite' (Sell/Buy/Sell), essentially hedging exchange rate relationship deviations across the three pairs. Entry involves initial positions, then adding positions when floating loss reaches a configured step threshold (supporting static, geometric, and exponential step progression). Exit supports both single-ticket and basket-ticket profit closing, with optional loss closing. Position sizing supports manual lot, auto lot (based on risk factor), fair lot distribution, and static/geometric/exponential/decreasing lot progression. Money management includes maximum lot limits, maximum order limits, spread filtering, trading session control, and slippage control.

pros: 多货币环形对冲设计在理论上能对冲单一货币对方向性风险，降低单边暴露
支持3至8种货币灵活配置，最多56个环组，组合覆盖面广
提供丰富的仓位管理和资金管理选项（步进递进、手数递进、自动手数、公平手数）
有订单数上限、点差过滤、交易时段控制、滑点控制等多层风险防护
Plus/Minus双套组设计允许用户选择单向或双向对冲，灵活度较高
pros_en: Multi-currency ring hedging design theoretically hedges directional risk of individual pairs, reducing unilateral exposure
Supports flexible 3-8 currency configuration with up to 56 ring groups for broad combination coverage
Rich position sizing and money management options (step progression, lot progression, auto lot, fair lot sizing)
Multi-layer risk protection including order limit, spread filter, session control, and slippage control
Plus/Minus dual suite design allows users to choose one-directional or bi-directional hedging flexibly
cons: 亏损加仓机制（步进加仓）本质是网格/马丁类策略，在极端行情下可能导致账户爆仓
默认不设止损（TypeCloseInLoss=Not_Close_In_Loss），浮亏可能无限扩大
同时操作最多56个环组×3对×2方向=336个仓位，对账户保证金和点差成本要求极高
大量全局变量和硬编码数组（MaxGroups=57）使代码可维护性差，容易出错
缺乏真正的套利逻辑——没有检测三对间定价偏差的指标，入场时机完全依赖加仓步进而非市场信号
cons_en: Loss-adding mechanism (step-based position increase) is essentially a grid/martingale strategy that can blow accounts in extreme markets
Default no stop-loss (TypeCloseInLoss=Not_Close_In_Loss) allows unlimited floating loss expansion
Operating up to 56 groups × 3 pairs × 2 directions = 336 positions simultaneously demands extremely high margin and spread costs
Massive global variables and hardcoded arrays (MaxGroups=57) make code poorly maintainable and error-prone
Lacks true arbitrage logic—no indicator detecting pricing deviation among three pairs; entry timing relies entirely on step-based adding rather than market signals
improvements: 引入三角套利定价偏差指标（如合成汇率与实际汇率之差）作为入场信号，而非纯靠浮亏加仓
强制设置止损或最大浮亏限制，防止极端行情下账户爆仓
将全局变量重构为结构体/类，减少命名冲突风险并提升可读性和可维护性
improvements_en: Introduce triangular arbitrage pricing deviation indicator (e.g., synthetic vs actual rate difference) as entry signal instead of pure loss-based adding
Enforce mandatory stop-loss or maximum floating loss limit to prevent account blow-up in extreme markets
Refactor global variables into structs/classes to reduce naming collision risk and improve readability/maintainability

risk_points: 亏损加仓（网格/马丁式）在趋势行情中可导致指数级仓位增长和账户爆仓
默认不设止损，浮亏无上限保护
同时管理大量仓位（最多336个）对保证金消耗极大，可能触发保证金追缴
环形对冲在极端相关性破裂时（如闪崩）三对可能同时亏损，对冲失效
risk_points_en: Loss-adding (grid/martingale style) can cause exponential position growth and account blow-up in trending markets
Default no stop-loss means unlimited floating loss exposure with no cap protection
Simultaneously managing up to 336 positions consumes enormous margin and may trigger margin calls
Ring hedging fails when extreme correlation breakdowns (e.g., flash crashes) cause all three pairs to lose simultaneously

summary_en: A multi-currency ring hedging EA that creates triangular currency pair groups from 3-8 currencies, generating up to 56 ring combinations. It opens simultaneous buy/sell positions across each ring's three pairs (Plus and Minus suites) to exploit temporary pricing imbalances, with configurable step progression, lot progression, and basket/single close logic.
